name: Sanctuary denied sensitive operation
description: Flags denied Sanctuary audit events for identity, state deletion, or reputation import operations.
query: event.dataset: sanctuary.audit and sanctuary.audit.decision: deny and event.action: (identity_sign or state_delete or reputation_import)

name: Sanctuary deny burst
description: Template rule for repeated deny outcomes in a short window. Tune the threshold in the tenant.

name: Sanctuary failed audit operation
description: Flags Sanctuary audit operations whose producer result is failure.
